rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something with considerable difficulty and effort.

example.english: I arduously got the report finished; it really wasn’t easy.
example.traditional: 辛辛苦苦咁整好份報告，真係唔容易。
example.jyutping: san1 san1 fu2 fu2 gam3 zing2 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan1 hai6 m4 jung4 ji6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on putting in a lot of effort or exerting oneself, rather than on suffering hardship.

example.english: We arduously played hard in this match and won.
example.traditional: 今次場波我哋落力咁踢，最後贏咗。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 lok6 lik6 gam3 tek3 zeoi3 hau6 jeng4 zo2
